title: A completed formal cover from liftable finite generating sections
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], $K$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, and $(F_n)_{n\geq1}$ a coherent formal module for $K$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $L$ be an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module] and $d\geq0$ an integer. Assume $H^1(X,\ker(F_{n+1}\to F_n)\otimes L^{\otimes d})=0$ for every $n\geq1$, with cohomology as in [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology] and tensor as in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Suppose $F_1\otimes L^{\otimes d}$ has a specified finite family of generating global sections [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]. Then there exist a coherent module $G$ [pqf-def-coherent] and a formal morphism $\alpha:G^\wedge\to(F_n)$ whose first component $G/KG\to F_1$ is epimorphic.

source.place: Lemma 0885 (lemma-existence-projective), first essential-surjectivity paragraph, from the chosen generating sections through the compatible maps and completed surjection

proof.text: Apply formal_twisted_transition_sections_surjective separately to each adjacent formal transition using the given H^1 vanishing. Choose a right inverse of each surjective section map and use Nat.rec, starting at the specified generating family, to construct compatible sections at every level.
Apply coherent_cover_from_compatible_twisted_sections to the constructed sections and P=L^d. It supplies a coherent module G and compatible ordinary maps g_n:G to F_n, with g_0 epi.

For each n, formalModuleQuotient_factor applied to g_n at equal ideal powers factors the ideal-product inclusion followed by g_n through K^(n+1) F_n. The formal-system annihilation condition makes that target zero, so the composite is zero. Define the quotient map a_n by cokernel.desc. Cancel the source quotient projection and use compatibility of g_n to verify adjacent naturality of a_n; NatTrans.ofOpSequence then constructs the complete natural transformation. Package it as a morphism of the full subcategory from completion(G) to F. Since the first quotient projection followed by a_0 is g_0 and g_0 is epi, epi_of_epi makes a_0 epi.

lean.statement: theorem formalModule_cover_from_lifted_sections {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (K : X.IdealSheafData) (F : CoherentFormalModule X K) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (d : ℕ) (hvan : ∀ k : ℕ, IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj (kernel (F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ k)).op)) (L.tensorPow d)))) (σ : (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj (F.obj.obj (op 0)) (L.tensorPow d)).GeneratingSections) (hσ : σ.IsFiniteType) : ∃ G : CoherentModules X, ∃ α : (completion X K).obj G ⟶ F, Epi (α.hom.app (op 0))
